verdict.rationale: Vanta is a SaaS compliance platform with its own AI Agent, so letting that agent consume external MCP servers is a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows the server side: Vanta publishes its own MCP servers for Claude, Cursor and others to call Vanta's API and developer docs. Nothing shows Vanta or its AI Agent acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools.
